titre: Do World Models Learn Global Understanding?
resume: arXiv:2609.34058v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI systems often feel brittle and fragmented. A large language model (LLM) may correctly explain a concept but fail to apply it, or follow safety instructions in one context but not another. This behavior suggests a general failure to lift local information to a global understanding. To gain fundamental insight, we frame "understanding" as learning constraints and propagating their consequences.
